culture_description: The Cinderweight bind harbor houses through witnessed measures and remembered debts. Chainhaven weighs copper, salt and cargo beneath the Hunger Below; Tolltooth keeps the lamps on the northern sea road. Children learn to read a balance before they learn to read a face, and a household's standing is written in the ledgers of those who owe it. A false weight is an oath broken before the counting hall. Before each season's trading, the merchant houses lower their first measured share into the sea fissure for the Silent Scale.
ruler_story: Vrekk Giltfang, the Brass-Tooth, lost part of his jaw when a rival challenged his copper weights. He returned with a brass tooth and bought the debts of the rival household. Their warehouse became his palace. He intends to make the other crowns depend on a harbor they cannot command.
dynasty_story: House Giltfang first settled quarrels over wreckage hauled onto steaming beaches. Its scales became accepted throughout the northern harbors, and the weighing fee paid for armed crews. The house keeps both the weights and the crown.
nation_story: Chainhaven lies inside a sheltered volcanic bay on Giltfang. Copper workings and salt pans supply its market, while the smaller island of Tolltooth watches the northern approaches. Limited grain and timber leave the merchant houses dependent on cargo from the older islands. Their first weighed offering descends into a sea fissure below the counting hall.
ambition_story: Hooktooth controls the old trade. Vrekk wants Chainhaven to become the northern exchange, buying provisions from Brackmaw and timber from Sootwake while hiring Reefhook pilots and bargaining with Shatterfin captains. He measures success in ships that cannot sail without his credit. Across the strait, the Stormfang of Shatter Maw outnumber his crews and owe his houses money. Vrekk considers their debts a guarantee of peace. His captains, watching Shatterfin's hulls multiply, are less certain.
event_description: Three petitions lie beneath Vrekk's brass-toothed grin. Drazk demands one honest set of weights for every warehouse; Skarra would send envoys to settle the harbor houses' accounts with the other crowns; Korrik wants the watch supplied before another storm. Each claims the whole island lives by their work. Outside, the lamps of Tolltooth burn beyond the channel.
event_answer: Let every harbor reckon with Chainhaven.
